overall_notes: The paper focuses on abstractive summarization of dialogue data. While it uses automatic metrics (ROUGE, METEOR) for evaluation, it also includes a human evaluation component via a question-answering task to measure alignment precision. The main NLG task is text summarization using the CRD3 dataset. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
